description:
## [0.0.9](https://github.com/zimza1abim/kanye-morphe-patches/compare/v0.0.8...v0.0.9) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* show patch screens and descriptions in English

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* build with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 and Gradle plugin 2.1.0

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support Bare 2.0.3, Titanium 157.0.8103.78
* support Bare 2.0.2, Titanium 157.0.8103.50

patches.name: Brave auto-hide toolbar with accessibility services
patches.description: Lets the address bar auto-hide while an accessibility service is on.

patches.name: Brave custom webpage fonts
patches.description: Renders webpages in your chosen font. Icons and emoji keep theirs. Restart the browser after changing.

patches.name: Brave font picker in settings
patches.description: Adds Settings > Appearance > Custom font. Use a font APK or a TTF, OTF or TTC file.

patches.name: Notesnook custom font
patches.description: Use a device font or a TTF, OTF or TTC file across Notesnook. Icons, emoji and math keep theirs.

patches.name: Bitwarden custom special characters
patches.description: Choose which special characters the password generator uses.

patches.name: Bitwarden passphrase total length
patches.description: Shows the total character count above a generated passphrase.

patches.name: Bitwarden trust re-signed browsers for passkeys
patches.description: Lets you trust Morphe-patched browsers for passkeys instead of failing the signature check.

patches.name: Anytype custom font
patches.description: Use a TTF or OTF font across Anytype. Settings > Application > Font.

patches.name: Hide tab close undo snackbar
patches.description: Hides the Undo bar after closing a tab. Closed tabs stay in Recent tabs.
